message: The order has already been Fulfilled or Cancelled.

error.message: The order has already been Fulfilled or Cancelled.
error.name: OrderAlreadyProcessed
error.remediation: the object or state already exists; treat the goal as met or pick a different target
error.description: The order id already has a terminal status: execution found it fulfilled, or `cancel_order` found any existing status for it. Check the `Orders` storage map under the blake2-256 hash of the SCALE-encoded `VersionedOrder`.

error.name: OrderCancelled
error.remediation: the window has closed; restart the flow with fresh state
error.description: The order was previously cancelled via `cancel_order` and can never be executed. Check the `Orders` storage entry for the order id; a `Cancelled` status is terminal, so the signer must sign and submit a fresh order.

error.name: CapabilityMissing
error.remediation: sign with the key or origin that owns the target object, then retry
error.description: No active capability authorizes this owner's purpose key. Install the intended Order or Message capability through the owner's authority before signing.

message: This full order has not been approved by its authenticated owner.

error.message: This full order has not been approved by its authenticated owner.
error.name: OrderNotApproved
error.remediation: sign with the key or origin that owns the target object, then retry
error.description: The account-approved order has no matching on-chain owner approval. Execute authorize_order through the owner's authority with the exact nonce and order.

error.name: CapabilityScopeViolation
error.remediation: the action exceeds a configured safety policy
error.description: The operation exceeds the installed capability's identities, fee, audience, per-order amount, or total spending limits. Obtain an appropriate owner-approved grant.
